Technician-workstation WPF app used to generate WinPE boot images and prepare USB
storage devices.

Deploy it with the MSI: it installs per-machine and takes the tenant configuration as
install properties, so there is no need to repackage the payload per tenant. See
`docs/setup-instructions.md` > "Deploying the Media Builder with Intune" for the full
deployment guide, including MSI properties.

### Driver sets on the USB drive

**Prepare USB Storage Device** has a new **Driver sets** section: choose models and Windows
releases, and Media Builder copies their driver files to the USB drive's CACHE partition, so
devices of those models do not download them. Files are downloaded and verified before the drive
is erased and kept locally for 30 days, so preparing several drives downloads once. Preloading
pins nothing: devices still get the driver set that is current when imaging starts.

Needs backend `mse-ci-v1.2.0`.

### Release artifacts
| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `cloud-imaging-mediabuilder-v1.2.0.msi` | Per-machine installer (x64). Configured via MSI properties; upgrades in place and keeps existing configuration. |
| `cloud-imaging-mediabuilder-v1.2.0.zip` | The same self-contained win-x64 payload (net10.0-windows), unpackaged, for xcopy deployment or custom packaging. |
| `SHA256SUMS` | SHA-256 checksums for integrity verification |
